description: Live global-intelligence data as a 39-tool MCP server: real-time markets, conflict events, country risk and resilience scores, shipping chokepoints, maritime and aviation activity, energy, climate, health, cyber threats, sanctions, forecasts, and AI-generated world/country briefs. Discovery is anonymous — connect and issue tools/list with no key. Every tool supports JMESPath projection so agents fetch exactly the fields they need. Data calls use OAuth2 or an API key from worldmonitor.app/pro.

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath projection applied to the response. See initialize.instructions for grammar and examples.

geo_context.description: Optional focus context (e.g. "Middle East tensions", "US-China trade war")

sources.description: Original feed articles used as grounding inputs for this brief.

summary.description: Alternate naming used by some upstream variants.

tool_signatures.name: search_flight_prices_by_date
tool_signatures.description: Search Google Flights date-grid pricing across a date range.

origin.description: IATA code for the departure airport, e.g. "JFK"

end_date.description: End of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath projection applied to the response. See initialize.instructions for grammar and examples.

start_date.description: Start of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format

destination.description: IATA code for the arrival airport, e.g. "LHR"

is_round_trip.description: Whether to search round-trip prices (default false). Requires trip_duration when true.

sort_by_price.description: Sort results by price ascending (default false, sorts by date)

trip_duration.description: Trip duration in days — required when is_round_trip is true (e.g. 7 for a one-week trip)

tool_signatures.name: search_flights
tool_signatures.description: Search Google Flights for real-time flight options between two airports on a specific date.

origin.description: IATA code for the departure airport, e.g. "JFK"

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath projection applied to the response. See initialize.instructions for grammar and examples.

max_stops.description: Max stops: "0" or "non_stop" for nonstop, "1" or "one_stop" for max one stop, or omit for any (optional)

destination.description: IATA code for the arrival airport, e.g. "LHR"

return_date.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format for round trips (optional)

error.description: Present when upstream returned a usable error message.
